host_before.phase: before second selected-feature pair, not sampled capacity during workloads
host_before.limits: visible CPUs and MemTotal are observations, not guaranteed exclusive allocation; standard cgroup quota files were unavailable

measurement_scope: caller-only identical real SDK code versus default dependency environment; necessary full FastMCP fixture separately counted

limits: Planned up to three fresh-cache AB/BA/AB pairs. Actual attempts/completions retained individually.
OS/DNS/CDN caches not flushed; uv caches are fresh, but this is not a network throughput experiment.
Apparent/allocated bytes exclude shared Python interpreter/stdlib and symlink targets; filesystem dedup unknown.
Cache retained bytes are not compressed network transfer bytes; uv link-mode=copy.
Default is full default server runtime, not optional test/browser/Galleria/model environments.
Pruned caller still requires real MCP/Pydantic and their fixed transitive runtime dependencies.
A separately measured full FastMCP server fixture remains required; this is not whole-service removal.
Two environments co-hosted cost full-server bytes plus client bytes, potentially more than one shared full environment.
Each batch has exactly two fixed client jobs against one real server; startup excluded from workload wall time.
Client wall time includes process startup/imports/calls/receipt writing; algorithm and server are unchanged.
RSS sampled every 20ms; sum RSS double-counts shared pages and can miss true peaks. Not PSS or enforced quotas.
Client ru_maxrss is sampled after workload, before receipt packaging; not final process-lifetime peak.
No external API/model/browser/Docker; loopback audit hooks are defense in depth, not an OS sandbox.
Output equivalence is confined to eight synthetic cases through both chat/direct paths.

tests.original_child_integration_test_limit: Retained unchanged. Trace collection and SDK boundary tests need FastMCP/test-only extras; no extra test closure installed. Full child suite/browser/model lanes not run.

terminal_accounting.fixture_exit_reason: intentional SIGTERM by finally cleanup after successful client jobs; all reaped
terminal_accounting.initial_terminal_checker_note: An ad-hoc receipt checker incorrectly required fixture exit0. Corrected to expected intentional SIGTERM; no workload rerun or receipt alteration.
terminal_accounting.fixture_server_denied_attempt_limit: The server audit policy rejects outgoing socket connects/DNS and child execution. Its in-memory denial list was not persisted; intentional SIGTERM may bypass its final check. Absence of blocked-operation errors in stderr is not a measured zero denied-attempt count.
terminal_accounting.external_api_call_scope: Only the fixed mock/error tool allowlist was sent and validated; outgoing server sockets were denied by the process audit policy. No live-source tool/API was exercised.

public_harness_derivation.change: Only execution-host uv absolute path replaced by <uv-0.13.4>; public copy is a reproducibility template, not the exact measured file. Set trusted installed uv path and record new hash before a fresh run.
